name: Rod of Wanton Destruction
description:
While wielding the rod, your rolls for spell attacks targeting inanimate objects are favored, and damage your spells deal to inanimate objects is doubled.

Once per day, you may activate the rod as a free action to make a roll for a spell attack targeting a creature favored, doubling any damage the spell deals. When you do so, roll a d8. On a 1, you become the target of the spell instead (the damage is still doubled).
